question: How long is a medical time-out?
expected_answer: One medical time-out of three minutes, for a treatable medical condition.
expected_phrase: one medical time-out of three minutes

question: In doubles, who serves in the third game of a set?
expected_answer: The partner of the player who served in the first game.
expected_phrase: shall serve in the third game

question: If my opponent shouts on purpose to put me off in the middle of a rally, who gets the point?
expected_answer: The hindered player wins the point (a deliberate act of the opponent is a hindrance).
expected_phrase: hindered in playing the point by a deliberate act of the opponent
note: The rules never say 'shouts' or 'put me off'; they say 'hindered' and 'deliberate act'.

question: A bird flies into the path of the ball during a point. What happens?
expected_answer: It is a hindrance and the point is replayed.
expected_phrase: hits a bird flying over the court
note: Answer lives in a Case example, like dev Q13. Tests the same weakness on a different rule.

question: Can my coach give me advice during a match?
expected_answer: On-court coaching is not permitted except in team events with a captain sitting on-court (when the sanctioning body allows it); never during the playing of a point.
expected_phrase: Coaching is not permitted during the playing of a point
note: The coaching text is repeated in Appendix IV, so any one phrase is enough. A good answer keeps the conditions (team events, sanctioning body); read by hand.

question: Can the balls be changed at the start of a tie-break?
expected_answer: No. A ball change does not take place at the beginning of a tie-break game; it is delayed until the beginning of the second game of the next set.
expected_phrase: A ball change shall not take place at the beginning of a tie-break game

question: If my racket touches the net while the ball is still in play, what happens?
expected_phrase: or the opponent’s court at any time while the ball is in play
note: Chosen so its answer chunk competes with Rule 25a (net contact that is a good return).

question: If my shot clips the top of the net and still lands in, is it good?
expected_answer: Yes. It is a good return if the ball touches the net but passes over it and hits the ground within the correct court.
expected_phrase: provided that it passes over any of them
note: Keyword check is loose (judgement answer, like dev Q6). Read by hand.

question: Can I volley the serve back?
expected_answer: No. If the receiver returns the service before it bounces, the receiver loses the point.
expected_phrase: The receiver returns the service before it bounces

question: How long can a tennis racket be?
expected_answer: No more than 73.7 cm (29.0 inches) overall length.

question: Is there a break after the third set of a best-of-five match?
expected_answer: Event organisers may allow a rest period of up to ten minutes, if announced in advance.
expected_phrase: after the 3rd set in a best of 5 sets match
note: A good answer keeps the condition (optional, announced in advance); read by hand.

question: How long can the warm-up last?
expected_answer: A maximum of five minutes, unless the event organisers decide otherwise.
expected_phrase: warm-up time shall be a maximum of five (5) minutes

question: How do you win a game once it reaches deuce?
expected_answer: By winning two consecutive points after deuce (advantage, then the game). The deciding-point version is an optional alternative procedure.
expected_phrase: needs to win two consecutive points immediately after
note: Trap: the PDF also describes an optional deciding point at deuce (alternative scoring). Same failure type as dev Q4 (optional rule presented as the default). Read by hand.

question: Who won the women's singles title at Wimbledon in 2024?
expected_answer: Refusal: the rules document says nothing about tournament results.
note: Tennis question the rules PDF can't answer; the model may know the winner (Barbora Krejčíková) and be tempted.

question: How do I hit a topspin backhand?
expected_answer: Refusal: the rules of tennis do not contain coaching or technique advice.
note: In-domain topic, but technique advice isn't in the rules.
